subject: VaultHealth: schedule for prompt/output/log purge + evidence transfer
messages:
From: Lauren Price <lauren.price@vaulthealth.com>

Cc: security@vaulthealth.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for VaultHealth (dataset VH-1243)

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Per our data residency policy and the VH-1243 contract clause, we need Redwood to execute a full removal of all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and any associated request/trace logs for the dataset tagged VH-1243 (created between 2024-12-01 and 2026-06-30).

Can you confirm the expected timeline and the exact evidence you will provide once the sweep completes? Specifically we need:
- A signed manifest listing object ids / S3 keys removed (or confirmation the objects were zeroed)
- A server-side run log with job IDs and start/end timestamps
- Confirmation that any KV/cache entries and ephemeral inference traces were flushed

We prefer the transfer of artifacts (manifest + run log) via a secure link or SFTP. Please advise available windows next week.

Thanks,
Lauren

Security Lead, VaultHealth

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for VaultHealth (dataset VH-1243)

Hi Lauren — thanks for the clear list. We can run the purge and provide the artifacts you requested. High-level plan below and a couple of questions to align on process: 

Planned workflow (short):
1) Lock write access to VH-1243 in the serving layer for the maintenance window
2) Snapshot metadata and queue a targeted purge job that removes prompt/input artifacts, generated outputs, and request/trace logs tied to VH-1243 IDs (we record job IDs)
3) Flush KV caches and clear any prefix cache entries related to VH-1243
4) Generate a signed manifest (PGP) that lists removed object identifiers and sha256 digests where available
5) Produce a CSV run log with job IDs, worker nodes, start/end timestamps, and verification checksums; deliver via secure link or SFTP; provide Ops ticket and HubSpot record for traceability

Questions / options:
- Preferred maintenance window: Tue 2026-11-09 02:00–05:00 UTC or Wed 2026-11-10 22:00–01:00 UTC (we can do either; the second has lower traffic for VH workloads)
- Delivery method: secure Drive folder (we will set link expiry and IP restriction) or SFTP. Which do you prefer?
- Do you require a separate notarized statement for regulatory audit, or will the signed manifest plus logs suffice?

I have attached our internal purge runbook excerpt for this class of requests; Marissa (ops) and Ben (security) are looped for execution and audit handoff. Once you confirm the window and delivery preference we will schedule the jobs and share the Ops ticket id.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Product Manager, Compliance
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Thanks, Irene — Wed 2026-11-10 22:00–01:00 UTC works for us (less business impact).

SFTP transfer is preferred for the artifacts. A couple of clarifications before you run the job: 
- Please include the worker job IDs and the process PID in the run log; we need these for our internal audit trail.
- If you are deleting S3 objects, please include either the deleted object versions or the zeroed-object confirmation (our legal team wants an immutable trail).
- Can you provide an estimated time-to-delivery for the manifest and CSV after the run completes?

If all aligns we will authorize the window; appreciate the runbook excerpt — looks good.

—Tim
